        f'H{row}<=INDEX($I$3:$I$9,MATCH(UPPER(B{row}),$A$3:$A$9,0))),"PASS","FAIL"),"FAIL")'
    )

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# Verification: print formulas written to J15:J17
